title: The story
metaTitle: The story of the Amber Inn, Eau Claire, since 1881
metaDescription: 145 years on East Madison Street: built by Walter Brewing in 1881, George Berg Soft Drinks through Prohibition, family-run since 1981. It never closed.

data.heading: 145 years on East Madison Street
data.intro: One building, one bar, from a brewery tied house in 1881 to the root beer still on the taps today.

data.subtitle: The room is the same one Walter Brewing built. Come sit in it.
